transcript: Speaker A: C for cat, D for dog jaisi angrezi toh seekh li. Lekin aaj tak English mein dhang se sentence nahi bol paate? Aise toh tumhari koi izzat nahi karega. Isse accha tum aaj ke aaj is wale app pe roz sirf 10 minute English ki practice karke dekho. Phir dekhna kaise farratedar English bolte ho. Is app ko English Seekho app kehte hain. Yahan sirf sikhane wale videos aate hain aur English Seekho app par koi ads bhi nahi aate. Dekho, English Seekho app pe Spoken English yaani bolne wali angrezi ka ek show aata hai. Bas roz ka 10 minute nikalo aur English seekhne par lagao. Aur phir dekhna kuch hi dino mein tumhari English dekh ke log dang reh jayenge. Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [You have learned basic English vocabulary like C for cat and D for dog, but still cannot speak proper sentences. No one will respect you like this. Instead, practice English for just 10 minutes daily on this app. You will speak fluently soon. This is the English Seekho app, featuring educational videos without ads. It has a Spoken English show. Just spend 10 minutes daily to learn. Soon, people will be amazed by your English. Click install to download the app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho : Speaking App, Seekho App, 10 min, ENGLISH, Basic Level, Medium Level, Advance Level, Spoken English, INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority or brand. Used for educational purposes only. No guaranteed results.
summary: The ad highlights the social embarrassment of not being able to speak English fluently. It presents the 'English Seekho' app as an ad-free solution requiring only 10 minutes of daily practice. The call to action prompts users to install the app.
